summary:
I reproduced all six checks myself on the worktree branch indices-pricing (fffc8d98). I built the site once, after waiting for another worktree's build to finish, served it on port 4815 and then stopped the server. No file in the worktree was changed.

(1) Merge bcd0b136: nothing of either side is lost. Main's side (eddbf384) is kept whole in CLAUDE.md, metric.md and versions/README.md. Main already carried the branch's D62 exception, the "does not do X" rule and the v1-default and v0-noise lines. docs/product.md has the D44 amendment rewritten (a field left empty is a price not known). docs/method.md has the F-63 amendment, including fee-unknown. docs/design-system.md has the D62 sentence and the HoldTallest row. It also has the row for a list whose rows change with a pick in another list, with PickList states/cases/canShow and the 1.2 s hold, plus MixedName, AlsoChanged and the renamed catalog row. In box-check.mjs every line the branch added is present except two that were rewritten on purpose (the comment's date and the chip click, now made after onScreen), and main's on-screen measure and --whole are kept. One limit: main has moved on since, and landing the branch will conflict in three docs.

(2) Decisions on the page. The ten current_account records match the report: Hapoalim 5.30, Leumi 5.50, Discount 5.90, First International and Massad 6.30, Mercantile 6.40, Mizrahi-Tefahot 6.80, Jerusalem 9.50, Yahav 4 and One Zero 0. Each matches its research note. I marked each bank on the default S&P 500 plan (10,000 ₪ plus 500 ₪ a month, 10 years, 7%). The change in each bank's figure is proportional to its minimum, as expected: Leumi +673 ₪, Yahav +489 ₪ and Jerusalem +1,161 ₪, about 122 ₪ per ₪ a month. Leumi goes from 82,723 ₪ in third place to 83,396 ₪ in second, which matches the report. The current account is set only in routes/invest.tsx, so no other page counts it. I did not separately check D67 on the page. By the code and the engine test, the per-event charge applies only to a fund bought abroad that pays dividends.

(3) Marking a bank changes only that bank's figures in the account list and in the stairs' 'other account, same fund' table. Marking Jerusalem also moves the stairs' example starting point, which is consistent because the stairs start at Jerusalem. The line under the list is held at its longest case, and the page height does not change. However, the list re-sorts on the screen after a mark, and the chosen row is not held. The box check misses this because it measures at 650 ms.

(4) The D65 and D66 notes appear once each, in one fold, on the S&P 500, MSCI ACWI, MSCI World and Nasdaq-100 pages. They are absent on TA-125, TA-35 and TA-90. The D65 sentence implies that the three named houses have their spread cap in the calculation, but the engine prices it only for IBI.

(5) I looked at my own whole-page screenshots at 1440 and 390 (S&P 500, TA-125, TA-35, Nasdaq-100; no bank, Leumi marked, fold open). There was no horizontal scroll and no console errors, and I saw nothing broken by this change.

(6) Typecheck, tests (1,657 passed, 1 todo) and data validation passed. The build failed once on a prerender timeout under a load average of 74 and passed when run alone.

I did not repeat the finance reviewer's findings unless they are visible on the page.

Evidence files are in /tmp/claude-1000/-home-ori-dev-finance-tool/d699993e-48cb-44ea-a321-d53b3c193f71/scratchpad/pricing-check/: box-sp500.txt, box-ta125.txt, sp500-pc.out (the per-bank marking diffs), the shots/ folder, and the scripts mark.mjs and resort.mjs.
